race.title: Irishinjuredjockeys.com Claiming Race
race.verdict: SHOOT TO KILL is better here than anywhere else and looks the most solid option on these terms. Justenzia did well to win over further here on Friday and is another to consider, while Leonie is capable of going very close if seeing out the longer trip for her new yard. SHOOT TO KILL (IRE) JUSTENZIA (IRE) LEONIE
